title: 1988 Leaf #9 Andre Dawson Chicago Cubs Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1988 Leaf Donruss trading card featuring Andre Dawson of the Chicago Cubs. It is card number 9 in the set and is part of the MLB league. This sports trading card is not autographed and was manufactured by Leaf in the year 1988. The card showcases Dawson during the 1988 season of his career in baseball. It is a collectible item for fans of the Chicago Cubs or Andre Dawson.
